journey.title: The exchange from start to finish
journey.subtitle: Six simple steps: from your profile to a review.

j1.title: Fill in your profile
j1.text: Add skills to “I can teach” and “I want to learn”, pick languages and a time zone. Matching opens after that.

j2.title: Get your matches
j2.text: We show people with full and partial matches: filters for skill, language, level and rating.

j3.title: Send a request
j3.text: Propose an exchange to the person you chose. They can accept, decline or not answer in time.

j4.title: Agree on a time
j4.text: Chat with text, voice and files. Propose lesson times with time zones taken into account.

j5.title: Learn on video
j5.text: A 45-minute lesson right in your browser. A counter shows how many lessons each side taught, keeping it fair.

j6.title: Finish and review
j6.text: After the exchange, leave mutual reviews on four criteria: good teachers see their rating grow.

safety.title: Safety and fair rules
safety.subtitle: We make sure every exchange is safe for everyone.

k1.title: 16+ only

k2.text: Exchanges are mutual. Money transfers between users are forbidden.

k3.title: Moderator only in a dispute
k3.text: A pair’s chat is read only after a complaint, and only with the consent you give at sign-up.

k4.title: Blocking and reports
k4.text: You can block a person so they can no longer message you.

authPromo.title: Teach what you know. Learn what you love.
authPromo.text: Find a partner, agree on a swap and grow together: no fees, just knowledge.
authPromo.quote: “I reached B1 German in four months and taught 30 hours of Python along the way.”
authPromo.step1Text: Say what you can teach and what you want to learn. We match you with partners for a mutual swap.
authPromo.step2Text: Send a request, plan in chat and schedule lessons at a time that suits you both.
authPromo.step3Text: Lessons run in a video room right on the site. Afterwards you leave each other honest reviews.
